about: Exact-string edits applied to the HiGHS 1.14.0 source archive before highspy is built with CUPDLP_GPU=ON, each file checked by its sha256 before and after (docker/variant_gpu/edit_source.py). python-highs.cmake: HiGHS's Python build compiles no CUDA source even with CUPDLP_GPU=ON, so the module would hold unresolved cuPDLP-C GPU symbols; the edit links the C++ build's own cudalin library. cuda/CMakeLists.txt: the library is built for sm_75, sm_80 and sm_86 only; sm_120 (Blackwell) is added, because PTX from this CUDA 13.3 compiler cannot be JIT-compiled by a driver that reports an older CUDA 13 line. No version label is added: the module reports highspy 1.14.0, as the profile's wheel does, so a program that checks its pins or prints versions gives the same answer on both images; /opt/gpu/variant.json and libcudalin beside the module say it is the CUDA build.

replace:
install(TARGETS _core DESTINATION highspy)
install(TARGETS _core DESTINATION highspy)

# optimization-gpu: the GPU PDLP (cuPDLP-C on CUDA) linked into the Python module. HiGHS's own Python
# build compiles no CUDA source even with CUPDLP_GPU=ON; this adds the C++ build's `cudalin` library,
# links it and the CUDA libraries into `_core`, and installs it beside `_core` (found by $ORIGIN).
if (CUPDLP_GPU)
  set(CUPDLP_INCLUDE_DIR "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/highs/pdlp/cupdlp/")
  add_subdirectory(highs/pdlp/cupdlp/cuda EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  target_link_libraries(_core PRIVATE cudalin ${CUDA_LIBRARY})
  install(TARGETS cudalin LIBRARY DESTINATION highspy)
endif()
